description_en: Queries the password policy for Resource Access Management (RAM) users
description_zh: 查询RAM用户的密码强度策略信息
name: GetPasswordPolicy

HardExpire.description_en: Indicates whether logon is blocked after the password expires
HardExpire.description_zh: 密码过期后是否限制登录

InitialPasswordAge.description_en: The validity period of the initial password

InterceptRiskPasswordOnApi.description_en:
Indicates whether threat passwords are blocked when set using APIs.

Valid values:

true

false (default)
InterceptRiskPasswordOnApi.description_zh:
使用OpenAPI设置密码时，是否拦截风险密码的开关。

取值：
true：使用OpenAPI设置密码时，新密码不得为风险密码。
false：使用OpenAPI设置密码时，新密码可以为风险密码。

默认值：false

MaxLoginAttemps.description_en: Maximum number of failed password attempts

MinimumPasswordDifferentCharacter.description_en: The minimum number of different characters in the password
MinimumPasswordDifferentCharacter.description_zh: 密码中最少包含的不同字符数量

PasswordNotContainUserName.description_en: Indicates whether the password must not contain the user name
PasswordNotContainUserName.description_zh: 密码中是否不允许包含用户名

RequireLowercaseCharacters.description_en: Indicates whether the password must contain lowercase letters
RequireLowercaseCharacters.description_zh: 密码中是否必须包含小写字母

RequireNumbers.description_en: Indicates whether the password must contain numbers
RequireNumbers.description_zh: 密码中是否必须包含数字

RequireSymbols.description_en: Indicates whether the password must contain special characters
RequireSymbols.description_zh: 密码中是否必须包含符号

RequireUppercaseCharacters.description_en: Indicates whether the password must contain uppercase letters
RequireUppercaseCharacters.description_zh: 密码中是否必须包含大写字母
